newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Australian share funds have good 96/97 - survey.
newsitem.headline: Australian share funds have good 96/97 - survey.

text.p: Tyndall Australia Ltd was Australia's best performing equities fund manager in the year to June 30, according to the lastest fund performance survey by InTech Consulting.

InTech said the top performing fund managers over the 1996/97 year were Tyndall, which achieved a 51 percent return for its Australian share fund, followed by BNP Equities, which returned 39.8 percent on its share fund.
The funds' performance was helped by the 26.6 percent rise in the Australian Stock Exchange's (ASX) All Ordinaries Acumuation Index for the 1996/97 year.
InTech said the worst performing funds were LGT with a 20.8 percent return, Schroders with 21.7 percent and Legal and General with 23.0 percent.
It said the average Australian shares specialist fund in the InTech sector performance survey over this period out-performed the index by 2.3 percent, returning 28.9 percent.
